rationale: Alex's focus on ML developer tooling and infrastructure complements Arya's work building agent-first tools—specifically, as Arya scales LeSearch AI and LeCoder MConnect, they'll need robust tooling and infrastructure to support agentic systems at scale. Both are based in San Francisco and share deep expertise in Python and machine learning, making for a natural technical collaboration on the infrastructure challenges unique to agentic AI.
intro_message: Alex Kreidler, meet Arya Teja Rudraraju — Alex builds ML developer tooling at Mercor and Arya is scaling agentic AI tools at LeSearch AI, and they could explore how infrastructure and tooling for agents fits together.
